name: UtilityRebillingRubs
tagline: Recover master-metered utility bills from residents – fairly, auditably, inside Power Apps.
description: A complete ratio utility billing (RUBS) app in one PCF control: allocate water, sewer, trash, gas and other master bills to units by occupants, area, fixtures, bedrooms or a blend, with vacancy borne by the owner, common-area deductions, caps, admin fees, four-eyes review, disputes, resident statements and a status board. Works instantly in demo mode and connects to collections, Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Six allocation methods incl. occupant factors and blended weights
Common-area deduction, caps and admin fees
Four-eyes review, confirmations, disputes and undo
CSV export of bills, allocations and statements
Power Fx outputs and events; DOM event for Power Pages
Phone layout with bottom view bar; keyboard and screen-reader support
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
controlType: standard (2 controls: UtilityRebillingRubs data-set with Items + Units data sets, UtilityRebillingRubsPortal field)
